jobs.title: Project Manager / Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Revolutional
delivers advanced technology solutions and mission support to federal agencies across civilian, health, and national security environments. We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes.

We are redefining how federal technology gets built and delivered by operating with a product mindset, prioritizing speed, ownership, and execution over bureaucracy.

Description

Title: Project Manager / Scrum Master

Location:
Remote

Terms:
Full-time

Salary:
$125-145k DoE

Clearance: Public Trust

Travel: 0%

Position Description

We are seeking a Project Manager / Scrum Master to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience leading and managing cross-functional Agile Scrum teams to plan, develop, and launch mission-critical Federal Government web applications and content management systems. The Project Manager / Scrum Master will oversee the entire project lifecycle, from initial discovery and design through full website build, launch, and post-launch operations, ensuring that all deliverables meet rigorous performance, quality, and security standards.

Responsibilities

Provide overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control, and completion of Federal IT web development projects from initial kickoff to final deployment.
Serve as Scrum Master for Agile development teams, facilitating all Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Direct the end-to-end management of a new enterprise Drupal Content Management System (CMS) website from initial setup and architecture through go-live and ongoing maintenance.
Coordinate closely with creative design partners, UX/UI specialists, content strategists, and technical teams to ensure seamless visual design integration, web accessibility (Section 508 / WCAG 2.2), and brand alignment.
Manage complex project schedules, assess conflicting priorities, eliminate technical blockers, and track team velocity and project health using key metrics and earned value analysis.
Proactively identify potential project risks and issues, develop mitigation and contingency plans, and maintain a comprehensive risk register.
Ensure all contractual deliverables and performance standards adhere strictly to Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASP) and Federal security and privacy requirements.
Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact, maintaining transparent communication with government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and program managers through weekly status meetings and monthly progress reports.
Foster a collaborative team culture, conducting regular one-on-one meetings, coaching team members, and maintaining high morale across multidisciplinary technical and creative staff.

Requirements

U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field with 8+ years of hands-on experience in project management and Agile best practices.
Experience managing full-lifecycle enterprise web development and CMS deployment projects.
Demonstrated experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing multidisciplinary technical, creative design, and content teams.
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Active Agile Certification (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent experience.
Proficiency with Agile management tools (e.g., Jira) and project scheduling software such as MS Project.
Strong analytical, organizational, client-facing, and oral/written communication skills.

Desired

Experience leading Drupal website development projects from start to launch.
Experience managing and coordinating work with external creative design partners, multimedia agencies, and UX/UI teams.
Experience managing Federal Government Contracts.
Familiarity with Cloud hosting environments (such as AWS or Azure) and cloud deployment workflows.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-enabled site features or assistants.
Knowledge of Federal security authorization processes (FISMA, NIST SP 800-53) and Section 508 / WCAG 2.2 web accessibility compliance standards.

jobs.title: Principal Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse’s mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.

About The Role

As Principal Project Manager, you will be a project expert responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing all aspects of supply chain projects to ensure delivery within scope and budget. You are the primary point of accountability for project success and coordinating teams within the Enterprise Supply Chain (ESC) Category Management Center of Excellence.

You will report to the Supply Chain Spend Management Supervisor, within the Enterprise Supply Chain (ESC) Category Management Center of Excellence .

This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Change Management

Define scope, objectives, milestones, and success criteria; build integrated project plans (charter, WBS, schedule, RAIL log, Risk Register).
Lead complex cross-functional projects from assessment through implementation, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned initiatives and ensuring objectives, timelines, deliverables, risks, actions, and stakeholder expectations are clearly managed.
Use process reviews, partner feedback, and operational reporting to identify process gaps, root causes, initiative needs, and opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and results.
Develop current-state and future-state process documentation, project plans, action trackers, and standardized best practices to support sustainable improvement.
Present executive-ready updates including project status, key milestones, risks, decisions needed, financial or operational impacts, and recommended next steps.
Facilitate project governance through weekly standups, monthly steering reviews, and gate approvals.
Drive change management activities, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, training, adoption tracking, reinforcement of new processes or tools, and clear messaging to impacted teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Category Management, Procurement, SIOP, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, APX, Logistics, Finance, IT, and our teams to understand requirements, align priorities, and drive improvement initiatives.
Facilitate meetings, lead working sessions, and deliver executive-level presentations to align partners, communicate recommendations, summarize progress, and drive project execution.
Bridge project teams, business stakeholders, and leadership by consolidating feedback, escalating issues, documenting decisions, and maintaining throughout the project lifecycle.
Support system enhancements, process automation, and report improvements across departments.

Reporting & Business Support

Translate business findings into clear insights, recommendations, and presentation-ready materials that support decision-making and stakeholder adoption.
Review operational and financial information from multiple systems and sources to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and new initiative opportunities.
Develop and maintain ad hoc reports, recurring project updates, executive summaries, and presentation materials for leadership, executive teams, and partners.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in an engineering field, supply chain, project management, finance, or a related field; Master's degree preferred; equivalent related experience may be considered.
8+ years of experience in project management, business process improvement, change management with 2+ years leading supply chain projects.
Experience driving change management efforts, managing scope, schedule, and project budget across multiple sites/functions.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, identifying risks, and driving enterprise-wide programs.
Experience working with Category Management, Supply Chain, Operations teams, Finance, internal or external partners.
Continuous improvement mindset and experience with process optimization.
Professional certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, Lean or similar project certifications (in process or willing to get).

Westinghouse is committed to transparency and equity in all people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $103,300 to $129,000 per year.

Latent Health is redefining how healthcare systems unlock the power of clinical data. Through our AI-powered platform, we streamline clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve health system efficiency. We partner with leading hospitals and health systems to deliver fast, reliable, and high-impact implementations that transform patient care.

Role Overview

The Implementation Project Manager
is responsible for leading end-to-end onboarding and deployment projects for health systems adopting Latent’s platform. You’ll drive timelines, coordination, communication, and successful activation across clinical, IT, integration, and operational stakeholders.

This role requires exceptional organization, customer-facing presence, and the ability to operate in the dynamic environment of a high-growth healthcare SaaS startup. You will ensure customers go live efficiently, achieve measurable value quickly, and are set up for long-term success.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Customer Delivery

Lead full-cycle implementation projects – from kickoff through go-live and stabilization – across a portfolio of health system customers.
Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk logs.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings with customer IT, clinical operations, and technical teams (e.g., data integration, SSO, EHR workflows).
Serve as the primary project point of contact, ensuring exceptional communication and alignment across all parties.

Technical Coordination

Coordinate collection and validation of required technical inputs (integration specifications, data feeds, configuration requirements).
Partner with Latent engineering, product, and clinical teams to ensure smooth handoffs and timely execution.
Understand and translate technical requirements to non-technical stakeholders (and vice versa).
Monitor progress of integrations (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and escalate blockers proactively.

Operational Excellence

Own project documentation, including requirements tracking, decisions, status updates, risk mitigation plans, and post-go-live handoff materials.
Build repeatable processes and contribute to the evolution of Latent’s implementation playbooks and best practices.
Track and report project KPIs (e.g., activation timelines, milestone adherence, customer readiness).
Ensure clean transition to Support teams post-implementation.

Customer Relationship & Change Management

Build trusted relationships with clinical and operational leaders at customer sites.
Guide customers through workflow adoption, training readiness, and change-management planning.
Ensure customer stakeholders understand project expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
Drive customer accountability to keep projects on track and on time.

Qualifications

Required

3-7 years of project management experience in healthcare, SaaS implementations, or health IT.
Strong understanding of healthcare environments – clinical operations, IT workflows, data integrations.
Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and navigate competing priorities.
Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com).
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

Preferred

Experience implementing solutions with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
PMP, CSM, or other project management certification.
Background in clinical workflow optimization or healthcare operations.
Prior experience in Series A-C SaaS or health-tech companies.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Customers consistently launch on time, on budget, and with high satisfaction.
Clear, proactive communication minimizes surprises and escalations.
Implementation cycles shorten over time due to improved processes and customer readiness.
Cross-functional teams view you as a trusted coordinator and problem-solver.
Customers transition seamlessly to Customer Success with strong early adoption signals.

Why Latent Health

Mission-driven team transforming healthcare through cutting-edge AI.
Fast-growing environment with opportunities for career growth.
Deep collaboration across clinical, technical, and product teams.
A chance to make a real impact on clinician workflows and patient outcomes.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Software Implementation (Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution & Benefits)
jobs.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together

At TELUS Health, we're transforming how organizations manage retirement and benefits for their employees. Our Retirement & Benefit Solutions team partners with leading Canadian and US companies to implement and modernize Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, and Health & Welfare benefits administration platforms.

As a Project Manager, you'll be the connective tissue that keeps our implementation projects on track. You'll work directly with a senior project lead to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery initiatives—helping ensure that our clients successfully transition to modern benefits platforms while our internal teams stay aligned, informed, and empowered to do their best work.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and client success. You'll see your impact immediately—from the moment you help organize a kickoff meeting to the day a client goes live on their new platform. You'll also have the opportunity to modernize how we work by exploring Agile and DevOps practices, and by leveraging AI tools to streamline reporting and documentation.

If you're organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping teams moving forward together, this could be the right fit.

What you'll do

Day-to-day, you'll:

Coordinate implementation delivery across cross-functional teams (Configuration, Data, QA, Product, Development, Integration, Operations, and client stakeholders), keeping everyone aligned on scope, schedule, and milestones
Own project tracking and reporting—creating and maintaining detailed plans, action logs, risk/issue/dependency (RAID) logs, milestone trackers, and status materials that inform leadership and clients
Facilitate working sessions and team meetings, document decisions and action items, and follow up to ensure accountability
Spot risks and dependencies early and partner with senior leaders on mitigation strategies
Prepare client-facing status updates, deliverable tracklists, meeting materials, and follow-up communications—helping maintain strong client relationships and confidence
Support hands-on delivery activities: plan configuration, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, contributions, data migration, systems testing, interfaces, and operational readiness
Uphold PMO governance by applying templates and standards consistently across all projects
Experiment with modern delivery practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) to improve how our teams plan and execute
Use AI tools and copilots to boost your own productivity—drafting meeting notes, summarizing actions, writing status reports, and handling routine communications more efficiently
Contribute ideas to improve how we deliver, report on progress, and work as a team

This role is about solving puzzles. You'll manage multiple dependencies across teams, navigate complexity, and create clarity in situations where there are lots of moving pieces. You'll also be a trusted point of contact for both internal teams and clients who need someone they can rely on.

What you bring

To succeed, you'll have:

2–3 years of project management experience, ideally supporting:
Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, or benefits administration implementations
Benefits technology or software implementations
Client-facing implementation projects

Foundational knowledge of project delivery methodologies—Waterfall, Agile, hybrid, or a mix of approaches
Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
Practical awareness of pension and benefits concepts like plan rules, eligibility, enrollment, contributions, data exchange, interfaces, testing, and go-live readiness
Comfort using generative AI and automation tools to improve your own productivity, documentation, project tracking, and reporting

It's a bonus if you have:

Experience supporting Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution, or Health & Welfare benefits implementation projects
French language skills or experience supporting French-speaking clients and teams
Hands-on involvement in platform implementations, client onboarding, annual/open enrollment cycles, data migration, or testing activities
PMP certification (or you're working toward it)

Above all: You're organized, proactive, detail-minded, and energized by keeping teams aligned and moving forward. You communicate clearly, take initiative to solve problems, and genuinely enjoy coordinating complex work across multiple groups.

Salary Range:
$70,000 - $90,000

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.

TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:

Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
Generous company matched pension
Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills

Why TELUS Health

You'll be part of a team modernizing benefits administration for thousands of organizations across North America. Your work helps employees access the retirement and health benefits they've earned—so you're contributing to something meaningful. Plus, you'll have opportunities to grow your project management skills, explore new delivery approaches, and leverage emerging technologies like AI to work smarter every day.

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. About Skylight
Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.
We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.
If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.
The work we do matters.

About the job
At Skylight, engagement managers are responsible for driving the overall success of our client work. They draw on their expertise in areas such as agile project management practices, agile coaching at the organizational and team levels, project status and progress reporting, risk/issue management, stakeholder management, continual improvement, and contract administration in order to deliver the highest levels of client service and work.
Skylight has partnered with the U.S. Air Force across multiple legacy modernization efforts. The work spans modernization of legacy systems, new capability development in multi-vendor environments, iteration on established platforms, all inside an agile transformation and broader organizational change.

You’ll lead this engagement end to end: owning the client relationship, keeping delivery on track across several teams and vendors, and shaping how Skylight grows the account. It’s a highly complex and consultative environment, so you’ll spend as much time aligning stakeholders and enabling your government partners as you do managing the work.

Your first 30 days are about working with the Skylight team and government personnel, learning the client’s domain and organization, and enabling your government partners. Access to users varies from team to team, so you’ll need to get creative about how you reach them. The client is early- to mid-transformation, so expect organizational and operational change along the way.
This role is contingent on Skylight being awarded the underlying contract. If we’re not awarded the contract, we’ll let you know promptly and discuss whether there are other opportunities that fit.

What you’ll do
Translate the client’s objectives and constraints into an engagement approach that’ll deliver a unique experience and impactful results in the shortest amount of time possible
Build trust with a wide range of stakeholders across the client organization, partner vendors, and Skylight, and keep them aligned on priorities and progress
Manage multiple projects aimed at delivering transformation or a specific product using the appropriate methodologies (e.g., Scrum or kanban)
Set up the team for successful delivery by removing obstacles, coaching them on how to become more collaborative and self-organizing, and enabling the work they do rather than impose how it’s done
Identify opportunities to expand Skylight’s work with the client, and help shape proposals, renewals, and account strategy
Provide management- and team-level visibility into the status and health of the engagement

Basic qualifications
Understand how to apply agile principles to project and program management
Ability to understand client needs and build long-lasting, meaningful relationships with them
Ability to grow Skylight’s business through business development activities
Can cultivate team health, including establishing psychologically safe environments
Can ensure that each project is staffed with the appropriate level and types of personnel
Can ensure that teams are compliant with their contract’s terms and conditions
Strong stakeholder management skills in complex, multi-vendor environments
Interest in mentoring, coaching, and pairing with government partners so they can carry the work forward
Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery
A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves
Military or government experience
Experience leading legacy modernization or agile transformation efforts
Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings
A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Other requirements
Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.
All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.
This contract requires U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment.
You must be able to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC), which requires a favorable background check.
You must complete a company background check successfully.

Position type
This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location
This is a fully remote position.

Travel
Expect occasional travel to Air Force bases across the U.S., quarterly at most.

Expected start date
November 2026

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! To that end, we use the results of our interview process to determine what salary is most appropriate given your current level of seniority. Senior Engagement Manager: $150,000–$185,000
Staff Engagement Manager: $170,000–$203,000
Principal Engagement Manager: $180,000–$230,000

jobs.title: Deployment Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Axe Compute is seeking a Deployment Program Manager who can track multiple simultaneous GPU cluster deployments end to end, report progress to clients and internal stakeholders up to the executive team and Board, and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies across every workstream that has to come together to bring a cluster live. This role requires genuine fluency in the GPU cluster deployment lifecycle, not just generic project management.

ROLE AT A GLANCE

Mandate: Own program management for multiple concurrent GPU cluster deployments, from contract signature through customer go-live.
Scope: Multi-workstream project planning, cross-vendor coordination (OEMs, data center operators, network service providers), client and executive/Board reporting, risk and dependency management.
Key Outcomes: Predictable contract-to-go-live timelines across concurrent deployments, accurate and proactive risk identification, reporting that satisfies both client stakeholders and executive/Board audiences.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Multi-Cluster Program Tracking

Build and maintain sophisticated, dependency-aware project plans covering every workstream in a deployment: OEM hardware manufacturing and shipment, data center build-out, cluster build-out and provisioning, and network service provider dependencies.
Track multiple concurrent deployments simultaneously, on a global scale, maintaining a clear view of status, risk, and critical path across all of them.

Client & Executive Reporting

Produce and deliver progress reporting to client stakeholders, translating technical status into terms relevant to their go-live planning.
Produce and deliver internal reporting to executive leadership and the Board, summarizing status, risk, and financial impact of deployment execution across the portfolio.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Proactively identify risks, issues, bottlenecks, and cross-workstream dependencies before they affect schedule or budget.
Own risk mitigation planning and escalation, coordinating the right stakeholders to resolve issues quickly.

Cross-Vendor & Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate directly with OEM manufacturers on hardware orders and shipment timing, data center operators on build-out schedules, and network service providers on connectivity dependencies.
Work with the Lead GPU Cluster Solution Architect, Data Center Procurement and Operations Director, and Supply Chain to ensure every workstream is reflected accurately in the project plan.

Technical Fluency Across the Deployment Lifecycle

Maintain working knowledge of GPU architecture and the full set of components and phases that go into building a cluster from scratch: data center readiness, equipment delivery and installation, vendor coordination (MSPs, data center operators, OEMs), and acceptance testing cycles.
Use this fluency to ask the right questions, spot schedule risk early, and communicate credibly with technical stakeholders on all sides.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years in program or project management for infrastructure, data center, telecom, or large-scale technology deployments, with direct experience managing multiple concurrent, complex projects.
Demonstrated understanding of GPU cluster architecture and the end-to-end deployment lifecycle (data center readiness, hardware delivery/installation, network turn-up, acceptance testing).
Experience coordinating directly with OEM manufacturers, data center operators, and network/connectivity vendors.
Experience producing reporting for both client-facing and executive/Board-facing audiences.
Strong tools proficiency (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar) for complex, multi-workstream project tracking.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

PMP certification or equivalent.
Prior experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler, or GPU infrastructure provider.
Familiarity with NVIDIA Reference Architecture and cluster acceptance testing standards.

Description

At AWS, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, driven people. The team is seeking a Technical Program Manager II (TPM II) to serve as the Global Process Owner (GPO) for one of our global maintenance programs — owning the standard end-to-end, from definition through global execution and continuous improvement. You will be a highly visible owner who drives the communication, coordination, cross-organizational consensus, and execution of a multi-year program vision, and who owns the decision and unblocks the path forward when consensus cannot be reached.

Our Serviceability team owns serviceability excellence across AWS's global data center fleet. We set and maintain the preventive-maintenance (PM) standards, critical-spares strategy, and operational readiness testing programs for the electrical, controls, mechanical, and generator infrastructure that keeps AWS data centers online. We operate on a Global Process Owner (GPO) model: each Technical Program Manager owns a global program end-to-end — defining the maintenance standard, driving it through a gated review-and-approval lifecycle, and stewarding it globally across every AWS region. We turn field data into standardized, data-driven maintenance decisions that reduce risk, extend asset life, and lower cost at fleet scale.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of infrastructure, software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Travel up to 25%.

3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least October 7, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Addison, TX, USA; Thornton, CO, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in technical program management.
Experience in network reliability or network health management for hyperscale optical networks (e.g., long-haul terrestrial dark fiber, metro networks, or carrier hotels).
Experience planning and executing network migrations or infrastructure expansions (e.g., capacity planning, asset transitions, or fiber route upgrades).

Preferred qualifications:

5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Knowledge of regional network providers and fiber networks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a data-driven problem-solving approach to solve issues.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of this team, you will plan, design, and acquire the scalable network infrastructure to deliver the fastest, most reliable experience to users across the region and around the globe. You will connect Google's fleet of data centers, Cloud customers, and users by planning and acquiring long-haul and metro terrestrial dark fiber networks, colocation space and power, and other critical assets.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Collaborate with internal business and cross-functional networking technical teams to identify and define tactical initiatives necessary to meet Google's network infrastructure needs for both expansion and cost optimization.
Translate demand forecasts into regional capacity plans over time, taking into account market trends and technology changes to ensure the most optimized and cost effective network solution, translating this to asset/infrastructure requirements.
Present network plans and roadmaps for approval by all internal stakeholders that range from short-term augments to long-term region-wide strategies for Google network.
Manage the execution of approved network plans by co-ordinating with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on-time and within allocated budget.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Mission Systems - Active Clearance
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking a highly motivated Program Manager to own a portion of a growing portfolio of government reference architecture programs. In this role, you'll be the single point of ownership for the programs assigned to you, partnering with engineering, contracts, and government stakeholders to keep technical, cost, and schedule baselines aligned and commitments met. You'll bring both architectural fluency and execution discipline: blending the technical depth to hold your own in an open systems trade discussion with the rigor to drive milestone and risk burndown, and the credibility to represent your programs directly to the customer. This is a high-impact role for someone who is energized by breadth, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and ready to take on additional scope as the portfolio grows.

What You'll Do

Manage and facilitate systems engineering execution across open architecture teams and associated adopting teams of those architecture
Drive execution across multiple efforts and are accountable to tactical sprint to sprint outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of Anduril platforms, autonomy, simulation, and perception products through the creation and maintenance of systems engineering artifacts
Weigh in on overall strategy as well as specific implementations alongside Lead Systems Engineers and Chief Engineers
Build integrated schedules and allocation plans alongside Lead Systems Engineers and Chief Engineers

Required Qualifications

5+ years of progressive experience in program management on government or defense programs, including direct ownership of cost, schedule, and technical performance
Active US Secret clearance
Experience with systems engineering and/or software engineering
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships across internal and external organizations
Proven track record as the primary interface to a government program office, running program reviews and technical interchange meetings and representing program status directly to the customer
Experience managing schedules and resources to achieve program objectives
Highly organized: able to manage concurrent programs and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment

Desired Qualifications

Ability to obtain and hold a US Top Secret clearance
Experience with MOSA or open systems standards work, including participation in a GRA consortiums
Demonstrated ability to grow scope over time, taking on additional programs or complexity as a portfolio matures
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced technical degree a plus

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

At Components Express, a 2Connect company, we help customers solve complex connectivity challenges through high-performance cable assemblies, engineered products, and custom solutions. Combining local expertise with the global strength of the 2Connect Group, we deliver innovative, reliable solutions to industries where performance matters most.

As our Program Manager

Work on innovative technologies supporting the semiconductor industry.

Enjoy opportunities for professional development, leadership growth, and international exposure.

jobs.description:
Open to remote work except in South Dakota, Vermont and West Virginia.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $149,100.00 in our lowest geographic market to $313,900.00 in our highest geographic market. Actual salary will vary based on a candidate's location, qualifications, skills and experience.

Information About Benefits Can Be Found Here.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Principal Information Security Analyst
to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) team within Corporate Information Security (CIS). This role is a senior individual contributor and program leader who will deliver against an information security and cybersecurity assessment plan integrated into a broader enterprise risk management program supported by executive management.

You will leverage deep expertise in security policies, standards, controls, and industry best practices to perform and lead risk assessments of Nike systems and systems managed for Nike by vendors. You will also drive strategic advancement of Nike's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—establishing risk-profiling methodologies, tiered assurance frameworks, vendor lifecycle controls, and executive reporting capabilities that protect Nike's most sensitive data across a complex global vendor ecosystem.

Our ideal candidate is a trusted advisor with superb communication skills, exceptional analytical and problem-solving ability, intellectual curiosity, and proven experience translating complex security risks for both technical and non-technical audiences—including executive leadership, procurement, legal, privacy, and technology partners. You thrive in cross-functional environments, influence without authority, and bring a principal-level perspective to program design, not just execution.

Beyond assessment execution and program delivery, this role carries a broader organizational mandate. You will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in information risk and cybersecurity not only within CIS, but across Nike. Partner teams including Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, and the broader Nike Business will look to you as a trusted, accessible authority on information risk. You will also identify, initiate, and lead cross-functional programs that extend beyond IRM’s immediate scope, efforts such as enterprise-wide data governance alignment or cross-team risk standardization, bringing structure and momentum to problems that span organizational boundaries.

What You Will Work On

This role works with the Information Risk Management team to identify, assess, elevate visibility to, and remediate information security risks across Nike's technology landscape. As a Principal-level contributor, you will lead high-complexity assessments, shape team methodology, mentor analysts, and own key TPRM program initiatives.

Key Responsibilities Include

Third-Party Risk Management Program Leadership

Advance TPRM capability maturity by designing and implementing program rigor beyond control self-assessments, including vendor risk profiling, risk-based controls testing, and tiered assurance requirements
Establish and operationalize a standardized vendor risk-profiling methodology (e.g., data sensitivity, criticality, regulatory impact) to consistently categorize vendors by inherent risk tier and drive risk-based assessment prioritization
Define and implement tiered assurance requirements so that higher-risk vendors undergo deeper validation (evidence reviews, control testing, security baseline documentation) while lower-risk vendors follow appropriately scaled processes
Introduce targeted validation of high-impact controls (e.g., access management, data protection, availability) for critical suppliers, going beyond self-attestation to validate design and operational effectiveness
Establish mandatory control effectiveness standards requiring vendors to demonstrate effective design and operational execution for high-impact controls prior to contractual engagement or network integration
Develop and operationalize TPRM metrics and executive reporting, including third-party blind metrics and integration into Executive TPRM Council reporting
Expand factory risk assessment program scope and contribute to assurance activities for Nike's highest-risk indirect and direct third parties
Plan and execute joint response planning tabletop exercises with key direct and indirect suppliers to validate incident readiness and coordination capabilities

Vendor Lifecycle Governance

Close vendor onboarding gaps by designing and enforcing standardized, enterprise-wide onboarding controls to ensure no vendor obtains network access or data-sharing capability until a thorough risk assessment is completed
Build and steward a centralized vendor inventory capturing all active vendors, associated services, and data-sharing agreements, with inventory updates embedded into the global onboarding workflow
Design and enforce a standardized, enterprise-wide vendor offboarding process to ensure all vendor access and data-sharing channels are terminated promptly and consistently at contract end
Partner with Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and Technology to align vendor lifecycle controls across domains and drive measurable compliance with TPRM onboarding and offboarding requirements

Enterprise Risk Leadership & Cross-Functional Inf
luence

Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in information risk and cybersecurity across Nike, representing IRM and CIS with credibility and authority in forums, partner team engagements, and ad-hoc consultations
Embed with cross-functional partners, including Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, and Nike Business teams, to provide ongoing security risk guidance, ensuring these teams view information security as a strategic partner invested in their success
Identify emerging risks, capability gaps, and opportunities for enterprise-wide improvement that others have not yet surfaced, and drive action by building the case, gaining stakeholder alignment, and advancing solutions
Initiate and lead cross-team programs and initiatives that extend beyond IRM, such as enterprise data governance alignment, cross-domain risk standardization, or shared assurance frameworks, taking them from concept through operationalization with minimal oversight
When assigned to lead or support broader organizational initiatives, operate with full autonomy: set direction, engage stakeholders, build roadmaps, and drive execution end-to-end
Maintain and elevate the reputation of IRM and CIS by consistently demonstrating deep understanding of business context, delivering pragmatic risk guidance, and building trust as someone who gives direct, honest assessments of risk

Vendor Information Risk Assessments

Perform and lead formal risk assessments on partner and vendor connections, evaluating vendor processes at the point of engagement with Nike
Ensure sufficient validation of data sharing arrangements and agreements to protect Nike's sensitive information
Confirm business objectives align with the type and volume of data used, maintaining a "need to know/use" mindset
Review third-party SOC reports, security baseline documentation, and vendor security evidence as part of assessment activities
Establish risk and remediation ownership for identified vendor-related risks and document findings in the Risk Register
Serve as a senior escalation point for complex vendor risk decisions and exception recommendations

Security Controls Baseline Assessments

Lead assessments of complex platforms and systems against Nike security and configuration standards
Evaluate and process exceptions to information security policies and standards, providing principal-level recommendations on risk acceptance and compensating controls
Perform compliance control validation testing to determine the operating effectiveness of IT controls for scoped systems
Consult with technology units on IT general controls (ITGCs) and compliance matters
Champion information security policies, standards, controls, and processes so compliance requirements are addressed as part of business-as-usual operations

Internal Risk Assessments

Identify, document, and elevate visibility to information risk where business direction creates potential exposure to employee, athlete, and product sensitive data streams
Identify and profile Nike systems and processes that require risk assessments; scope and lead specific assessments accordingly
Perform detailed analysis of threats and vulnerabilities across information security domains including network security, asset security, security engineering, identity and access management, security operations, and software development security
Review key system configurations and complex IT infrastructures (e.g., cloud services, SaaS platforms, hybrid environments)
Communicate effectively through risk reports, presentations, and stakeholder interactions to drive remediation of identified risks

Data Analysis, Reporting, and Strategic Initiatives

Own vendor risk management metrics, reporting, and master data stewardship to improve accuracy, timeliness, and completeness

jobs.description:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

Liderar e desenvolver uma equipe multidisciplinar de Segurança de Rede com diferentes níveis de experiência, garantindo coesão, alta performance e crescimento contínuo de capacidades por meio de mentoring, feedback estruturado e planejamento de carreira.
Garantir a operação contínua, manutenção e evolução da infraestrutura de firewall e VPN do iFood, mantendo a segurança, disponibilidade e resiliência do perímetro de rede corporativo e de produção.
Supervisionar a arquitetura de segurança de edge multi-CDN do iFood, garantindo que a equipe administre efetivamente as políticas de WAF na Akamai e Cloudflare para proteger aplicações web, APIs e propriedades digitais contra ataques de camada de aplicação, OWASP Top 10 e vetores emergentes, mantendo alinhamento com o time de Fraud na ownership das regras de negócio no edge.
Conduzir estratégias de bot management e proteção contra crawlers, garantindo que a equipe equilibre controle de tráfego automatizado com acesso legítimo de negócio, e mantendo alinhamento com o time de Fraud para que as regras de negócio sejam owned e operadas pelo time adequado em vez de na camada de CDN.
Gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores de segurança, parceiros de CDN e provedores de infraestrutura, garantindo qualidade de serviço, conformidade contratual, continuidade e custo-benefício dos serviços contratados.
Supervisionar a segurança da infraestrutura de rede de escritório, incluindo administração de firewall, segmentação e controles de perímetro, apoiando a evolução planejada das operações de rede de escritório por meio de mentoring estruturado e transferência de conhecimento para o time receptor.
Conduzir a modernização da segurança de VPN e acesso remoto, incluindo iniciativas de ZTNA e migração de plataforma de VPN, em estreita colaboração com a Corporate Security.
Conduzir o desenvolvimento e a adoção de ferramentas de automação nas operações de segurança de rede, garantindo que a equipe construa e mantenha scripts e workflows que reduzam trabalho manual, acelerem detecção e resposta e simplifiquem o gerenciamento de configuração.
Definir e garantir o cumprimento de padrões, baselines e políticas de segurança de rede em toda a infraestrutura do iFood, garantindo postura consistente em ambientes corporativos, de produção e de empresas adquiridas.
Colaborar com CloudSec, CSIRT, CorpSec, DataSec e times de engenharia para alinhar controles de segurança de rede com a estratégia mais ampla de Platform Security, resposta a incidentes e iniciativas de inteligência de ameaças.
Participar de avaliações de fornecedores, revisões de arquitetura de segurança e seleções de tecnologia para ferramentas de segurança de rede, garantindo que as soluções atendam à escala, modelo de ameaças e requisitos operacionais do iFood.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

Experiência comprovada na gestão de firewalls em ambientes corporativos, incluindo configuração, ciclo de vida de políticas, upgrades, patching e troubleshooting de plataformas de next-generation firewall.
Forte expertise prática em gestão de VPN, incluindo arquiteturas site-to-site, acesso remoto e zero-trust network access (ZTNA), com experiência em iniciativas de migração e modernização.
Conhecimento profundo de administração de Web Application Firewall (WAF), incluindo Akamai Kona Site Defender e Cloudflare WAF, ajuste de regras, assinaturas customizadas, gerenciamento de falsos positivos e arquiteturas de segurança de edge multi-CDN.
Experiência na concepção e implementação de estratégias de bot management e proteção contra crawlers, incluindo rate limiting, análise comportamental, mecanismos de challenge-response e classificação automatizada de tráfego.
Sólida compreensão de arquitetura de segurança de rede, incluindo segmentação, design de DMZ, roteamento, listas de controle de acesso, segurança de DNS, TLS/mTLS, proteção contra DDoS e modelos de defesa de perímetro.
Experiência em gestão de pessoas com capacidade comprovada de liderar, mentorear e desenvolver equipes com diferentes níveis de senioridade, incluindo gestão de performance, planejamento de carreira e planejamento de sucessão.
Conhecimento de scripting e automação (Python, Bash ou equivalente), com disposição para expandir para infrastructure-as-code e operações de segurança de rede automatizadas.
Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e contratos em infraestrutura de segurança, incluindo SLAs, monitoramento de performance, ciclos de renovação e governança de nível de serviço.
Familiaridade com infraestrutura cloud (AWS) e ambientes Kubernetes, e a relação entre segurança de rede e domínios de segurança adjacentes (CloudSec, CSIRT, CorpSec e times de engenharia).

Para Realçar o Sabor:

Experiência no uso de ferramentas e plataformas de IA para aprimorar operações de segurança, detecção de ameaças e produtividade da equipe.

jobs.title: Airline Safety and Security Manager, BDL
jobs.description:
Location:
TDA AGH — Station-Based

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Schedule:
Standard business hours with flexibility to support station operations, safety events, and incident response as needed.

General Purpose Of The Job

Safety is not a department at TDA AGH — it is a culture. As Safety and Security Manager, you play a hands-on role in supporting and sustaining that culture at the station level. Working closely with station management and the TDA Safety team, you will help monitor safety compliance, support incident reporting and investigations, coordinate safety training, and serve as a visible, approachable safety resource for frontline teams. You will be responsible for a region of stations and travel as needed to support multiple operations.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, proactive, and genuinely passionate about keeping people safe. You do not need to have all the answers — but you do need to ask the right questions, follow through on every action item, and consistently model the safety-first behaviors TDA expects of everyone on the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Safety Compliance & Monitoring:

Support the Safety Management System (SMS) program by ensuring safety program elements are being carried out day-to-day.
Monitor station compliance with FAA, TSA, OSHA, IATA, and company safety standards; flag concerns to station management and the Safety team promptly.
Conduct routine safety walkthroughs, inspections, and risk assessments; identify hazards, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions.
Track and report safety and security trends at stations; escalate patterns or recurring issues to leadership.

Incident Reporting & Investigation Support

Assist station management in documenting and reporting safety incidents and accidents accurately and in a timely manner.
Enter and maintain incident records in the SMS management platform.
Support root cause analysis and help track corrective action items through closure.

Training & Safety Education

Coordinate and facilitate monthly station safety meetings and safety workshops.
Distribute and review safety educational materials; ensure all team members have access to current safety resources.
Support the delivery of required safety training through the Learning Management System (LMS); track completion and flag overdue items.
Serve as a visible safety presence — engage with frontline employees, answer safety questions, and reinforce safe behaviors in real time.

Administrative & Program Support

Ensure reporting and documentation requirements are complete and accurate for your stations.
Leverage data and Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) to drive actions.
Complete all required training.
Report any safety hazard or incident immediately per TDA SMS protocols.
Other duties as assigned by station leadership or the Director of Safety and Security.

Required

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience in the aviation industry or a similarly regulated operational environment.
Basic understanding of FAA, TSA, and OSHA safety regulations as they apply to airport ground handling operations.
Experience with IATA ground handling requirements and ISAGO certification standards.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to document incidents, track action items, and maintain accurate records.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Comfortable facilitating group safety meetings and communicating safety information clearly to frontline employees.
Must be able to work on the ramp and in operational areas as part of safety inspections and walkthroughs.
Must be willing to travel 30%.
Must successfully complete a 10-year background check and pre-employment drug screening.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred

Prior experience supporting a Safety Management System (SMS) program.
Experience with the ISAGO standards and certification requirements.
Experience using a Learning Management System (LMS) for training coordination.
OSHA 10-hour General Industry certification or willingness to obtain.
Prior ramp, ground handling, or airline operations experience strongly valued.

Work Environment

This is a station-based role that combines office work with regular time on the ramp and in operational areas. Exposure to outdoor environments including extreme weather conditions, aircraft noise, fuel vapors, jet exhaust, and ground service equipment is expected. Personal protective equipment is required and provided when working in operational areas.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to navigate airport ramp and operational environments safely, including walking on uneven surfaces and working around active aircraft and ground equipment.
Prolonged periods of sitting and computer-based work when in an office or administrative setting.
Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. occasionally.
Must have sufficient vision and physical ability to safely conduct site inspections and perform all essential functions of the position.

Key Competencies

Safety Mindset: Genuinely committed to keeping people safe; takes safety seriously every day, not just during audits or incidents.
Attention to Detail: Thorough and precise in documentation, inspections, and follow-up; nothing falls through the cracks.
Communication: Clearly conveys safety information to frontline employees and management; approachable, credible, and consistent.
Follow-Through: Tracks every action item, corrective measure, and training requirement to verified completion.
Proactive Awareness: Looks for hazards and trends before incidents occur; raises concerns early and constructively.
Collaboration: Works effectively with station managers, frontline teams, and the TDA Safety department; earns trust as a resource, not just a compliance checker.
Reliability & Accountability: Dependable and self-directed; takes ownership of the safety program at the station level with minimal supervision.
Adaptability: Adjusts priorities fluidly in response to operational changes, incidents, or evolving safety requirements.

Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

We have multiple openings for Project Managers
to lead project-management activities and support the planning and successful execution of high-impact technical projects addressing critical national security challenges. You will serve as a key project-management resource for milestone-driven research and development efforts in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Working closely with Associate Program Leaders, Principal Investigators, technical staff, and other project stakeholders, you will help organize project teams and coordinate schedules, budgets, milestones, risks, resources, agreements, reporting, and technical communications to enable successful project execution on aggressive timelines.

You will contribute to a growing portfolio of national security research and development initiatives in areas such as cyber-physical systems assurance, national security infrastructure, supply chain security, and disaster resilience. This position provides an opportunity to apply project-management, technical, and operational expertise to first-of-a-kind national security work while helping technical teams effectively organize, plan, coordinate, and execute complex activities. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division within the Engineering Directorate.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

These positions will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

In this role, you will

Lead day-to-day project-management activities for milestone-driven technical projects across cyber and infrastructure domains, including schedules, deliverables, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and project documentation.
Advise and support Associate Program Leaders and Principal Investigators in project team organization, resource coordination, budget tracking, scheduling, milestone planning, risk mitigation, and progress toward technical and programmatic objectives.
Gather, analyze, and synthesize scientific and technical information for project reports, proposals, milestone deliverables, sponsor communications, and decision briefings.
Coordinate technical and operational communications among project teams, collaborators, management, sponsors, and other stakeholders to support timely and effective project execution.
Identify and recommend improvements to established project-management and operational principles, methods, and tools to improve project execution, workflow, documentation, team coordination, and organizational processes.
Coordinate documentation, schedules, deliverables, funding information, and other activities associated with contracts, subcontract-related efforts, collaboration agreements, and external project partnerships.
Implement, maintain, and contribute to the improvement of project-management frameworks, tools, processes, and practices used to monitor budgets, schedules, resources, risks, milestones, and project performance.
Organize and facilitate project and team meetings, including schedules, logistics, agendas, presentation materials, decisions, action items, and follow-up activities.
Coordinate with staff and project-management personnel at other national laboratories and partner organizations to support communication, planning, team organization, resource coordination, milestones, and execution of multi-laboratory projects and consortia.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional Job Responsibilities, At The TSS.3 Level

Conduct complex technical and operational project-coordination activities under minimal direction, developing approaches, priorities, and solutions necessary to support successful completion of project milestones and deliverables.
Perform independent technical and operational analyses, synthesize project information, and develop recommendations to inform strategic project decisions involving schedules, budgets, resources, risks, priorities, and execution approaches.
Analyze and resolve complex project execution issues requiring in-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creative application of established project-management, technical, and operational methods.
Coordinate and prioritize multiple parallel activities involving competing requirements, changing priorities, or less well-defined assignments, and provide project leadership for defined activities by coordinating contributors and guiding execution toward project objectives.

Qualifications

This position requires an active DOE Q-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, project management, business, engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Comprehensive knowledge of project-management concepts, practices, and tools, with broad experience applying project-management principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to technical or operational projects.
Comprehensive experience independently coordinating established project schedules, budgets, milestones, deliverables, resources, risks, agreements, documentation, and other project execution activities.
Experience supporting project team organization and resource coordination, including aligning schedules, assignments, dependencies, and project needs across multidisciplinary teams.
Experience organizing and prioritizing parallel project activities with well-defined priorities and applying independent judgment to develop approaches and recommend process improvements within established practices and procedures.
Experience gathering and synthesizing technical or operational information and developing project reports, presentations, proposals, milestone documentation, or decision-support materials.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively collaborate in a multidisciplinary team environment and present and explain technical or operational information.
Effective interpersonal and organizational skills necessary to coordinate activities across organizational boundaries and work with technical staff, project leadership, management, external collaborators, and other stakeholders.
Ability to travel as required to support project activities and collaborations.

Additional Qualifications, At TheTSS.3 Level

Advanced knowledge of project-management and technical or operational practices, with significant related experience independently coordinating complex project activities, resolving project execution issues, and developing recommendations to inform project decisions.
Significant experience working under minimal direction to prioritize parallel activities, develop approaches to less-defined assignments, exercise independent judgment, and provide project leadership or guidance to other personnel.
Advanced communication and interpersonal skills necessary to provide advice to management and stakeholders, guide and mentor less-experienced staff, and effectively coordinate work across multidisciplinary and organizational boundaries.

Qualifications We Desire

Master’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, project management, business, engineering, or a related technical field.
Project Management Institute certification or equivalent project-management credential.
Experience supporting DOE, Department of Defense, other national security programs, or multi-institution research and development efforts, including applicable reporting requirements and process-improvement initiatives.

Pay Range

$129,150 - $196,476 Annually

$129,150 - $163,764 Annually for the TSS.2 level

$154,950 - $196,476 Annually for the TSS.3 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage.  An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Who Are We Looking For

Nike's Global Technology team is looking for a Change and Release Manager to join the FAST TPM Change & Release team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end change and release management processes that ensure the safe, reliable delivery of technology changes into Nike's production environments.

You are a detail-oriented, process-driven professional who thrives in a complex, cross-functional environment. You bring a solid understanding of change and release management fundamentals and are ready to put that knowledge to work across enterprise-scale technology programs. You are collaborative by nature — comfortable coordinating across development, operations, testing, and business teams to deliver successful outcomes.

Who Will You Work With

You will work closely with development, operations, testing, and business teams across Nike's Global Technology organization. You will coordinate with cross-functional technology stakeholders and partner with senior members of the Change & Release team to grow your expertise. You will report to a Lead or Manager within the FAST TPM Change & Release team.

What Will You Work On

Execute the change management lifecycle for assigned engagements, coordinating across development, operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure changes are built, tested, and implemented according to plan.
Review changes for risk, production system impacts, and air traffic control.
Set up and maintain change templates and services (CI/CD, Routine, Models) with senior peer review.
Conduct retrospectives and drive continuous improvement within the engagement area.
Monitor KPIs for assigned engagements to drive change rigor and standards.
Communicate change status and progress to stakeholders, with oversight from senior team members.
Lead release planning for standard-complexity engagements — defining scope, schedule, and objectives with oversight from senior team members.
Identify and manage release dependencies; proactively identify risks and develop mitigation strategies, including rollback plans.
Validate that releases are thoroughly tested before deployment; define success criteria and ensure environments are properly configured.
Develop detailed deployment plans including step-by-step instructions, rollback procedures, and Hypercare criteria.
Oversee deployment execution and monitor post-release performance and stability against defined success criteria.
Communicate release expectations, risk analysis, and air traffic control during PI Planning and across holiday periods.

Who We Are Looking For

Bachelor's degree required; 2–4 years of directly relevant work experience in change management, release management, technical program management, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
Demonstrated understanding of change and release management fundamentals, including the change lifecycle and risk management.
Experience coordinating technology changes across multiple cross-functional teams.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams.
Proactive risk identification skills — curious and thorough in understanding change scope, impacts, and dependencies.
Clear, concise communication skills with the ability to effectively convey status and progress to diverse stakeholders.
Ability to work independently with limited support once established in an engagement.
Agile mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.
Ability to analyze and interpret program and team operational data to support decision-making.
Experience with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow) and Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira) preferred.
Comfortable facilitating and participating in technical discussions with development, operations, and stakeholder teams.
