jobs.title: Airline Safety and Security Manager, PVD
jobs.description:
Location:
TDA AGH — Station-Based

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Schedule:
Standard business hours with flexibility to support station operations, safety events, and incident response as needed.

General Purpose Of The Job

Safety is not a department at TDA AGH — it is a culture. As Safety and Security Manager, you play a hands-on role in supporting and sustaining that culture at the station level. Working closely with station management and the TDA Safety team, you will help monitor safety compliance, support incident reporting and investigations, coordinate safety training, and serve as a visible, approachable safety resource for frontline teams. You will be responsible for a region of stations and travel as needed to support multiple operations.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, proactive, and genuinely passionate about keeping people safe. You do not need to have all the answers — but you do need to ask the right questions, follow through on every action item, and consistently model the safety-first behaviors TDA expects of everyone on the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Safety Compliance & Monitoring:

Support the Safety Management System (SMS) program by ensuring safety program elements are being carried out day-to-day.
Monitor station compliance with FAA, TSA, OSHA, IATA, and company safety standards; flag concerns to station management and the Safety team promptly.
Conduct routine safety walkthroughs, inspections, and risk assessments; identify hazards, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions.
Track and report safety and security trends at stations; escalate patterns or recurring issues to leadership.

Incident Reporting & Investigation Support

Assist station management in documenting and reporting safety incidents and accidents accurately and in a timely manner.
Enter and maintain incident records in the SMS management platform.
Support root cause analysis and help track corrective action items through closure.

Training & Safety Education

Coordinate and facilitate monthly station safety meetings and safety workshops.
Distribute and review safety educational materials; ensure all team members have access to current safety resources.
Support the delivery of required safety training through the Learning Management System (LMS); track completion and flag overdue items.
Serve as a visible safety presence — engage with frontline employees, answer safety questions, and reinforce safe behaviors in real time.

Administrative & Program Support

Ensure reporting and documentation requirements are complete and accurate for your stations.
Leverage data and Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) to drive actions.
Complete all required training.
Report any safety hazard or incident immediately per TDA SMS protocols.
Other duties as assigned by station leadership or the Director of Safety and Security.

Required

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience in the aviation industry or a similarly regulated operational environment.
Basic understanding of FAA, TSA, and OSHA safety regulations as they apply to airport ground handling operations.
Experience with IATA ground handling requirements and ISAGO certification standards.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to document incidents, track action items, and maintain accurate records.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Comfortable facilitating group safety meetings and communicating safety information clearly to frontline employees.
Must be able to work on the ramp and in operational areas as part of safety inspections and walkthroughs.
Must be willing to travel 30%.
Must successfully complete a 10-year background check and pre-employment drug screening.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred

Prior experience supporting a Safety Management System (SMS) program.
Experience with the ISAGO standards and certification requirements.
Experience using a Learning Management System (LMS) for training coordination.
OSHA 10-hour General Industry certification or willingness to obtain.
Prior ramp, ground handling, or airline operations experience strongly valued.

Work Environment

This is a station-based role that combines office work with regular time on the ramp and in operational areas. Exposure to outdoor environments including extreme weather conditions, aircraft noise, fuel vapors, jet exhaust, and ground service equipment is expected. Personal protective equipment is required and provided when working in operational areas.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to navigate airport ramp and operational environments safely, including walking on uneven surfaces and working around active aircraft and ground equipment.
Prolonged periods of sitting and computer-based work when in an office or administrative setting.
Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. occasionally.
Must have sufficient vision and physical ability to safely conduct site inspections and perform all essential functions of the position.

Key Competencies

Safety Mindset: Genuinely committed to keeping people safe; takes safety seriously every day, not just during audits or incidents.
Attention to Detail: Thorough and precise in documentation, inspections, and follow-up; nothing falls through the cracks.
Communication: Clearly conveys safety information to frontline employees and management; approachable, credible, and consistent.
Follow-Through: Tracks every action item, corrective measure, and training requirement to verified completion.
Proactive Awareness: Looks for hazards and trends before incidents occur; raises concerns early and constructively.
Collaboration: Works effectively with station managers, frontline teams, and the TDA Safety department; earns trust as a resource, not just a compliance checker.
Reliability & Accountability: Dependable and self-directed; takes ownership of the safety program at the station level with minimal supervision.
Adaptability: Adjusts priorities fluidly in response to operational changes, incidents, or evolving safety requirements.

The Analyst works closely with the Director of Trading & Investment Operations, senior analysts, Portfolio Management, Trading, Investment Services, Technology, Compliance, custodians, and other business partners.

The position provides an opportunity to develop increasingly sophisticated expertise in portfolio accounting, trading operations, investment systems, reconciliation, data analysis, and operational risk management.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities To Be Performed With Or Without Accommodation.

Portfolio Accounting & Reconciliation

Perform daily and periodic reconciliation of assigned investment portfolios.
Reconcile portfolio:
Positions and holdings
Transactions and trade activity
Cash balances and activity
Cost basis and tax lots
Income and corporate actions
Security and other applicable investment data

Compare information across portfolio accounting, custodial, trading, and other investment systems.
Identify reconciliation breaks and research the underlying cause.
Resolve routine discrepancies independently and escalate more complex exceptions appropriately.
Coordinate with custodians and internal business partners to resolve outstanding items.
Ensure adjustments and corrections are accurately processed and appropriately documented.
Monitor unresolved exceptions through completion.

Trading & Investment Operations Support

Support daily investment-operating processes associated with trading, settlement, portfolio accounting, and reconciliation.
Research transaction, settlement, position, and cash discrepancies.
Assist with investigation and documentation of trade-related exceptions.
Support validation of investment activity between order-management, execution, custodial, and portfolio accounting systems.
Assist senior team members with operational reviews and exception management.
Provide timely operational support to Trading and Portfolio Management.
Develop an understanding of the complete investment lifecycle from portfolio decision through execution, settlement, accounting, and reconciliation.

Investment Data & Systems

Maintain and validate investment and portfolio data within applicable systems.
Develop proficiency with the firm's investment technology environment, which may include:
Advent/APX
Moxy
Genesis
Eze/ESE
Bloomberg
FactSet
Custodial platforms and interfaces
Reconciliation and reporting applications

Research system and data-feed discrepancies.
Assist with validation of information transmitted among investment systems.
Escalate system issues, unusual data conditions, and recurring exceptions.
Support testing associated with system upgrades, implementations, conversions, and enhancements.

Reporting, Queries & Analysis

Create and maintain queries and reports supporting investment operations.
Develop exception reports and analytical tools designed to identify discrepancies and improve controls.
Use Excel and other analytical tools to reconcile, organize, validate, and analyze investment data.
Assist in developing management and operational reporting.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and manual processes.
Ensure reports and analyses are complete, accurate, and delivered within established deadlines.

Project Support & Process Improvement

Participate in investment operations, technology, data, and process-improvement projects.
Complete assigned project responsibilities in accordance with established milestones and deadlines.
Work with senior analysts and the Director of Trading & Investment Operations regarding project priorities and assignments.
Assist with documentation, data analysis, testing, validation, and implementation activities.
Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, controls, and workflow.
Assist in developing and maintaining procedures, process documentation, and operational controls.
Communicate project status and potential issues proactively.

Operational Controls & Risk Management

Perform assigned responsibilities in accordance with established operating procedures and controls.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails supporting reconciliation and operational activity.
Identify and promptly escalate unusual transactions, unresolved exceptions, errors, or potential control deficiencies.
Assist with root-cause analysis of recurring operational issues.
Support efforts to reduce manual processing, errors, and operational risk.
Maintain appropriate segregation of duties within assigned processes.

SEC/RIA Compliance Support

Perform responsibilities consistent with the firm's fiduciary obligations, policies, procedures, and applicable SEC/RIA requirements.
Maintain complete and accurate records within assigned areas.
Support Compliance reviews, internal audits, regulatory examinations, and information requests as appropriate.
Promptly escalate potential compliance or operational concerns.
Maintain confidentiality and appropriate security of client, portfolio, and investment information.

Internal Business Partnership

Provide responsive daily support to Trading, Portfolio Management, Investment Services, and other internal business partners.
Research and respond to operational questions within the Analyst's area of responsibility.
Communicate the status of open items, exceptions, and resolution efforts clearly and proactively.
Develop productive working relationships across the investment organization.
Provide accurate and timely information to internal stakeholders.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Required

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Basic knowledge of investments, securities, financial markets, or portfolio accounting.
Demonstrated analytical and quantitative aptitude.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work accurately with detailed financial and investment data.

Preferred

1–3 years of experience in investment operations, asset management, wealth management, trust, custody, brokerage, fund accounting, portfolio accounting, or financial services.
Experience performing financial or investment reconciliations.
Exposure to Advent/APX or comparable portfolio accounting platforms.
Exposure to Moxy, Genesis, Eze, Bloomberg, FactSet, custodial systems, or similar investment technology.
Experience developing queries, reports, or analytical tools.
Experience working within an SEC-registered investment adviser or other regulated financial-services environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Working knowledge of investments and financial markets with the ability to develop more advanced expertise.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to investigate discrepancies systematically and follow issues through resolution.
Ability to learn sophisticated investment systems and understand relationships among data sources.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently within established parameters and collaboratively within a team.
Intellectual curiosity and willingness to develop deeper technical and investment expertise.

Core Competencies

Accuracy & Quality
— Produces reliable work and recognizes the financial and operational importance of accurate portfolio information.

Analytical Thinking
— Uses data and structured analysis to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

Technical Aptitude
— Learns investment systems, data structures, and operational workflows quickly.

Accountability
— Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and follows issues through resolution.

Risk Awareness
— Recognizes exceptions and understands when escalation is appropriate.

Continuous Improvement
— Looks for opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and controls.

Collaboration
— Works effectively with Trading, Portfolio Management, Investment Services, Technology, Compliance, custodians, and vendors.

Development Mindset
— Actively builds investment, systems, and operational expertise.

Key Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

Accurate and timely completion of assigned portfolio reconciliations
Timely identification and resolution of reconciliation breaks
Reduction in aging or recurring exceptions
Accuracy of positions, transactions, cash, and cost-basis information
Quality and usefulness of queries and reports
Timely completion of daily operational responsibilities

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

SOCi is the leader in AI-powered marketing solutions for multi-location businesses. With its proprietary Genius AI™ and suite of Genius Agents™, SOCi provides a first-of-its-kind, AI-powered digital workforce capable of handling the workload of 1,000 local marketers™, empowering brands to achieve unmatched digital visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and scale faster than ever before.

SOCi is recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies, and is trusted by nearly 1,000 top brands—including Ford, Ace Hardware, Kumon, Liberty Tax, and more—to automate and optimize local marketing tasks across all locations. Founded in 2012 and backed by leading strategic investors, SOCi is transforming how multi-location brands manage and scale their marketing efforts. You can view our Awards and Accolades here!

About The Role

We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-oriented Revenue Operations Analyst
to support our Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing organizations. This role will serve as a key operational partner across the customer lifecycle, helping teams operate efficiently through strong queue management, Salesforce administration and reporting, Customer Success operations, and cross-functional process management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across multiple teams, can translate business needs into operational solutions, and has advanced Salesforce reporting skills. This person should be equally comfortable investigating an operational issue, building an executive-ready dashboard, coordinating a cancellation across multiple departments, and identifying opportunities to improve the underlying process.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Operations Queue Management

Own the day-to-day management of the Revenue Operations request queue.
Review and triage incoming cases, determine priority and appropriate ownership, and route requests to the correct Revenue Operations team member or functional owner.
Manage assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely communication and appropriate follow-up with stakeholders.
Monitor queue health, aging, volume, and resolution times to ensure requests are addressed within established service-level expectations.
Identify recurring requests and issues that may indicate opportunities for process improvement, automation, documentation, or enablement.
Maintain clear documentation of case resolutions and operational changes.

Customer Success Operations

Serve as a primary Revenue Operations point of contact and operational partner for the Customer Success organization.
Partner with Customer Success leaders and team members to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable processes, reporting, and system improvements.
Support changes and enhancements to Salesforce and other Revenue Operations tools used by Customer Success.
Partner closely with Customer Success Enablement to ensure alignment and understanding of processes, tools, documentation, and enablement assets impacted by operational changes.
Help document and standardize Customer Success operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability.
Support testing and quality assurance for system, workflow, and process changes before deployment.

Cancellation & Offboarding Operations

Manage and oversee the end-to-end customer cancellation process.
Coordinate across Customer Success, Implementation/Offboarding, Billing, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure cancellations are processed accurately and on time.
Perform quality assurance throughout the cancellation process to ensure required information is complete, systems are updated appropriately, and downstream teams receive the information they need.
Identify and resolve discrepancies or process gaps that could impact customer offboarding, billing, reporting, or revenue data.
Maintain documentation and controls to ensure a consistent and auditable cancellation process.
Analyze cancellation trends and surface insights or recurring operational issues to Revenue Operations and Customer Success leadership.

Reporting & Analytics

Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into accurate, actionable reporting.
Provide Clari and CAP reporting to Customer Success leadership as needed.
Build recurring and ad hoc reporting to support leadership decision-making and operational reviews.
Perform quality assurance and validation of reporting to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Investigate discrepancies across Salesforce and other revenue systems and partner with appropriate teams to resolve data issues.
Help establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key revenue and customer metrics.

Salesforce & Data Management

Serve as a Salesforce reporting subject matter expert within Revenue Operations.
Build and maintain advanced Salesforce reports, dashboards, report types, filters, formulas, and related reporting solutions.
Support data quality initiatives by identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate CRM data.
Partner with Revenue Operations and system administrators to recommend improvements to Salesforce fields, workflows, processes, and reporting structures.
Assist with user acceptance testing and quality assurance for Salesforce enhancements.
Help maintain documentation related to Salesforce processes, reporting definitions, and operational workflows.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
Document current-state and future-state processes, requirements, and standard operating procedures.
Partner cross-functionally to implement process improvements and measure their effectiveness.
Look for opportunities to reduce repetitive requests through automation, self-service reporting, documentation, and enablement.
Maintain strong attention to detail while balancing multiple requests, projects, and priorities.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical/operational role.
Strong Salesforce experience with an advanced understanding of reports and dashboards.
Experience working with CRM data and translating business requirements into reporting or operational solutions.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
Strong project and process management skills with the ability to manage work from intake through completion.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple departments.
Ability to prioritize competing requests and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable identifying problems, recommending solutions, and taking ownership through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.
Experience supporting Customer Success operations and customer lifecycle processes.
Experience with Clari or similar revenue intelligence/forecasting platforms.
Experience with ticketing or case-management workflows.
Experience working with customer cancellation, offboarding, billing, or renewal processes.
Experience with data visualization or business intelligence tools.
Familiarity with revenue metrics including ARR, churn, retention, renewals, pipeline, and forecast reporting.
Experience identifying opportunities for workflow automation and operational scale.

SOCi expects to pay a base salary in the range of $60,000 to 80,000 CAD base salary. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

What SOCi Provides To You

Comprehensive Benefits Package (full-time permanent, non-contract roles only)
Health insurance plans, dental, and vision
Wellness incentives
401(k) plan with employer match

Flexible Work Environment (full-time, non-contract roles only)
Flexible paid time off
Quarterly wellness days
Paid holidays
Unique employee engagement programs

Empowering Career Growth and Success

What’s Important At SOCi

Led by a team of industry experts, SOCi is leading the pack in agentic marketing for multi-location brands. Our passionate team of SOCialites work from home around the globe!

Our collaborative, dynamic culture allows our teams to work cross-functionally and optimize productivity. We are a fast-paced, agile environment where thought leadership and input are encouraged. If you are looking for a place where you can come and make a difference in the way enterprise organizations utilize social technology, then SOCi is for you. Visit soci.ai for more information.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst (TID) is part of the Transit Technology team within the Transformation & Technology Department. The Transit Technology team is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining dispatching systems and other technology tools that enable MBTA Operations division to deliver safer, more efficient, and more reliable transit services. This role will work closely with Transit Tech product teams to measure and monitor the success of technology products and initiatives as part of outcome-driven technology delivery.

The Data Analyst (TID) will empower stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and create a culture of continuous improvement. The position will collect, clean, and validate data, perform statistical analyses using modern data analysis and visualization tools, communicate findings, and write technical documentation. The Data Analyst will collaborate with other team members to share knowledge, provide cross-training, and jointly support cross-divisional projects.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design dashboards, visualizations, graphs, charts, and tools that clearly communicate outcomes, findings, and trends of Operations data.
Proactively build and maintain positive and effective relationships with Departments. Work with Departments to analyze results, forecast current and future needs, assess performance, and evaluate strategic opportunities.
Communicate with and present to executive leadership project results and findings.
Gather, analyze, and interpret operational data using a combination of SQL, Excel, Python and/or relevant modern data analysis tools.
Perform quality control on data inputs, calculations, algorithms, and model outputs, and investigate associated data gaps or inconsistencies.
Develop tools to facilitate the automation and dissemination of analyses.
Prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports, slideshows, and other visual reports incorporating narratives and graphic data, for both online and print formats.
Manage timelines, project milestones, and communications with internal and external partners.
Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or coworker, in a courteous and professional manner consistent with the Authority’s quality standard.
Work directly with Operations Leadership to identify the needs specific to the assigned division.
Collaborate with other Analysts on the knowledge sharing, cross-training, and joint support of cross-division projects.
Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

Additional responsibilities may include a focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

Supervision

No direct reports.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in business, finance, economics, computer science, data science, urban planning, engineering, or a related field.
Two (2) years of experience in data science, business analytics, business intelligence, quantitative analysis, or other related fields.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. As part of the interview process, an Excel assessment may be required.
Experience in at least one approach to advanced data analysis (e.g., SQL, Python, R, SPSS, GIS, or other).
Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and use creative and collaborative approaches to resolve issues.
Effective organizational, analytical, multi-tasking, and time management skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Possess strong statistics and data fundamentals.
The ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce.

Preferred Experience & Skills

Experience with relational databases (e.g., Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle), including writing queries to obtain and manipulate data.
Experience with Python, Excel VBA, or other programming languages, and/or data management and statistical analysis tools (R, SPSS, STATA, SAS, etc.).
Experience with Tableau or other visualization software.
Familiarity with transportation planning and transit systems, particularly the MBTA subway and bus network

Substitutions

A High School Diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
An associate degree from an accredited institution and an additional three (3) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
A master’s degree in a related subject substitute for two (2) years of general experience.
A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one year of experience.

Job Conditions

Ability to effectively read, comprehend, communicate, and respond to instructions, orders, signs, notices, inquiries, etc. in English.
Be at least eighteen (18) years of age, except if participating in an approved high school internship / co-op program.
Ability to commute to assigned work locations in the Boston, MA metro area, as required by the role.
Ability to provide internal and external customers with courteous and professional experiences.
Ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a diverse workforce team (or supervise, if required).
Ability to uphold the rights and interests of the MBTA while building and maintaining effective relationships with employees and co-workers.
Ability to adhere to rules, regulations, collective bargaining agreements (if applicable), and policies of the MBTA, including the EEO, anti-discrimination, anti-harassment, and anti-retaliation policies.
Have a satisfactory work record for the two (2) years immediately prior to the closing date of this posting (unless if current student or recent graduate), including overall employment, job performance, discipline, and safety records (infractions and/or offenses occurring after the closing of the posting and before the filling of a vacancy may preclude a candidate from consideration for selection).
Ability to pass a Criminal Offender Record Information (CORI) check, comprehensive background screening, and / or medical Clinic screening, potentially including physical examination and drug and alcohol screenings.
Ability to work all shifts and / or locations assigned, directed, or necessary for this position, including (for some transit / operations roles) up to twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week as necessary to accommodate severe weather conditions, emergencies, or any other circumstances that may potentially impact service or the safety of service.
Intern / co-op staff must be enrolled full or part-time in an accredited educational program and maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 2.5 for the entire duration of the internship / co-op. Additionally, interns / co-ops must have valid work authorization and U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting pre-employment screenings / pre-boarding, working in their positions, and throughout the duration of their program.

Disclaimers And Definitions

General Disclaimer: The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe a summary, general nature, and complexity of typical job functions and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required of staff assigned to this position.
Application Completion: It is each applicant’s responsibility to ensure application details are entered completely and correctly, including updated work and education histories (past and current). Incomplete applications may not be considered. Attachments do not substitute for application fields. The recruitment team does not have access to existing employee data / history.
Application Deadlines: Applicants should apply as soon as possible, as the MBTA may stop considering applicants after a sufficiently large applicant pool is established.
Work Environment: The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here-in are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. See job description for role-specific requirements.
Work Eligibility: All employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States and on an unrestricted basis. The MBTA does not have an employer work sponsorship program. However, if you have unrestricted work authorization, or are sponsored by a separate entity, you are welcome to apply. Further, all persons hired will require a U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting the position and employees will be required to complete a Form I-9 to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the U.S.

Candidates who do not attend their interview without advance authorization, including an email confirmation of a rescheduled time/date from Human Resources, will be considered a no-show and disqualified from consideration for the position. Related to rescheduling, on a one-time basis, and due to something emergent, you may be allowed to reschedule the interview. For terms, descriptions, and definitions related to diversity, equity, inclusion, veteran status, and immediate family members that you may find on the application form, please visit mbta.com/careers-app-definitions .
Intern / Co-Op Benefits: Employees taking part in an internship or co-op at the MBTA are eligible to receive accrued paid sick leave as well as a monthly transportation pass, based on the city from which the intern / co-op commutes to work, at no cost. However, no additional benefits are currently offered for interns or co-ops.

jobs.title: Sr Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Company

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start  Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Position Summary

As a member of the Cloud FinOps team at Optum Technology, you will work to align cloud and on-premises efficiencies with real-time business needs, compliance standards, and strategic stakeholder decisions. In this role, you will leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to analyze cloud usage, identify cost inefficiencies, optimize capacity, track performance metrics, and perform spend anomaly detection. Working closely with engineering, finance, and leadership teams, you will deliver actionable analytics that drive financial transparency, operational optimization, and cost accountability across our enterprise footprint.

Primary Responsibilities

Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement.
Evaluate emerging trends to inform solution design and strategic innovation.
Perform complex data analysis, cloud cost modeling, and capacity optimization to align resource utilization with real-time business needs and compliance guidelines.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to provide visibility into cloud spend, performance metrics, and spend anomaly detection.
Query, aggregate, and analyze large-scale multi-cloud usage datasets (e.g., AWS, Azure) to identify cost-saving opportunities and efficiency improvements.
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, product, and finance stakeholders to communicate financial insights, support budget forecasting, and guide data-driven decisions.
Conduct root-cause analysis on spend anomalies, usage spikes, and forecasting variances to maintain governance and accountability across cloud and on-premises environments.
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI \

Description

The Rapid & Rural Logistics (R2L) team is seeking a strategic Program Manager to lead AI Enablement across our high-growth operational businesses. R2L owns end-to-end customer fulfillment aspects including supply chain planning, operations, central programs, delivery, and technology. This role will design and implement frameworks that democratize AI capabilities, enabling teams to leverage AI to drive operational excellence through intelligent automation. This role requires a strategic leader who can balance executive stakeholder management with cross-functional coordination, change management expertise with technical fluency, and strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.

You will build the capability development programs, enablement frameworks, and partnership mechanisms that transform R2L employees into AI-capable problem solvers who can build self-help tools and prototypes using their business knowledge. This includes creating structured learning pathways that enable employees to graduate from foundational AI skills to active problem-solving, facilitating partnerships with Tech teams to scale prototypes into production solutions, and measuring success by how many employees are actively solving business problems with AI.

Key job responsibilities

Translate the AI enablement vision into executable roadmaps, designing programs that transform employees into AI-capable problem solvers through scalable playbooks, role-based pathways (AI Explorer, Practitioner, Champion), and an AI Champions network that fosters a culture of AI-first thinking
Design and execute programs that transform R2L employees into AI-capable problem solvers who can build self-help tools and prototypes using their business knowledge
Build scalable playbooks, role-based pathways (AI Explorer → Practitioner → Champion), and 'office hours' to support employees at varying levels of AI proficiency
Drive adoption of AI tools through internal communications, workshops, and an AI Champions network to foster a culture of AI-first thinking and active problem-solving
Partner with Tech teams, and other stakeholders to facilitate partnerships, scale prototypes into production solutions, and integrate AI into existing workflows
Enable employees to identify high-impact use cases, build proof-of-concepts, and articulate business value to Tech teams for scaling
Define and track KPIs for AI adoption (training completion, active tool usage, prototypes developed, solutions scaled), productivity gains, and ROI to provide transparency to senior leadership
Conduct impact assessments that quantify business outcomes from employee-built AI solutions, including productivity gains, quality improvements, and cost savings

Facilitate seamless collaboration and communication across distributed, matrixed teams, acting as the primary translator between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Continuous Improvement

jobs.title: Program Manager, Oncology Care Pathways
jobs.description:
About Viz.ai

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.

The Role

We're looking for an Oncology Program Manager to support the execution of Viz's oncology care pathways — and to own the operating system that lets them scale.

Working alongside our care pathway leads, you'll help get sites live, train and onboard the clinicians who use the product, build durable relationships across the oncology and urology community, and serve as the clinical voice for Sales and Customer Success. You'll also do something new for us: operate oncology as a program . That means one source of truth for site status and milestones, a clear operating rhythm across functions, clean handoffs, and escalation paths that work without requiring an executive in the room.

Oncology at Viz has real clinical momentum and real customer demand. It is also complicated by multiple dependencies and processes that need to get simpler — and success in this role depends on close collaboration with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Finance.

The ideal candidate combines the field credibility of a care pathway lead with the discipline of a strong program manager, and the instincts of someone who has worked inside an AI-native company and knows how fast the ground moves.

What You'll Own

Care Pathway Execution

Enable and coordinate oncology care pathway delivery from contract execution through technical go-live, clinical activation, and sustained use — through a combination of direct execution and a focus on process improvement.
Develop tight processes for planning, anticipating, and managing the site-side work that determines whether a site goes live on time: IT and EHR dependencies, IRB and research contracting, configuration, data validation, and clinical champion sign-off.
Work with clinical sales, demand generation, and marketing to build per-site activation plans and the pipeline behind them, so we're consistently carrying enough sites to hit commitments even when individual accounts slip.
Partner with Finance and our life sciences teams on the milestone implications of go-live timing, so the numbers people see reflect reality.

Clinician Onboarding, Training, and Adoption

Design and deliver onboarding and training for oncologists, urologists, APPs, navigators, and pharmacists at each activating site.
Build reusable training assets — quick-start guides, role-based walkthroughs, refresher sessions — so the tenth site is faster than the first rather than the same.
Monitor early usage after go-live and intervene before disengagement sets in, closing the loop with Product and Clinical AI on issues that surface in the field.

Relationships and Clinical Voice

Build and hold trusted relationships with clinical champions, service line leaders, and administrators at community urology networks, academic cancer centers, and large IDNs.
Serve as a site's point of contact through activation and early adoption, and know when to pull in colleagues rather than absorbing it alone.
Represent Viz at oncology and urology society meetings.
Support Sales and Customer Success in customer conversations, demos, and objection handling with credible, clinically grounded answers.
Contribute clinical input into product direction — workflow realities, guideline changes, what clinicians will and will not tolerate — in close partnership with Product, who owns requirements and roadmap.

Oncology Program Management

Establish a single, maintained source of truth for oncology: site status, milestones, owners, blockers, and dates. One place, current, that anyone from Sales to Finance to R&D can read without asking.
Establish clean interfaces, handoffs, and escalation paths across Clinical, Product, Engineering, Implementation, Sales, CS, Contracting, and Finance, with named owners.
Bring order to how oncology communicates, so technical and product issues have one home and site-level engagement and training have another — and hold that line as new work starts.
Build the reporting leadership and partners actually need, in collaboration with our platform and value demonstration teams.

Qualifications

5+ years in oncology or urology — clinical operations, care pathways, clinical program management, field medical, implementation, or customer-facing clinical roles — with real fluency in how cancer care is actually delivered.
Direct experience in the community urology or community oncology setting, including how these practices and networks make decisions, buy, and adopt new workflow technology.
Demonstrated multi-site, multi-stakeholder program or project management with hard deadlines — you're the person who keeps the tracker honest.
Experience at an AI-native or high-growth health technology company, with comfort in the pace, ambiguity, and frequent replanning that comes with it.
A track record of getting clinical sites live — and of closing the gap between "technically live" and "clinicians are using it."
Strong clinical fluency and credibility with oncologists and urologists, whether or not you hold a clinical license.
Excellent written communication, and a bias toward surfacing risk early with a plan attached.
Thrives in a role with broad surface area and limited established process — and is energized by building that process rather than waiting for it.

Bonus Qualifications

Experience supporting life sciences–sponsored clinical programs, including IRB, research contracting, and sponsor milestone reporting.
Familiarity with oncology and urology EHR and workflow systems (e.g., Epic Beacon, iKnowMed, OncoEMR, Athena).
Clinical licensure (RN, APP/PA/NP, pharmacist) or formal clinical training a plus, but not required.
Working knowledge of NCCN guidelines and how guideline updates propagate into clinical decision support.
Experience with Salesforce, Monday.com, or comparable tooling for program and pipeline tracking.

How We Think About Care Pathway Execution

A care pathway is not delivered when the technology is live. It is delivered when clinicians change what they do because of it.

Most of what stands between those two states is not technical. It is coordination — who owns the next step, whether anyone is tracking it, whether the site heard back, whether the person who can unblock it knows they are blocking it. We're looking for someone who finds that work interesting rather than beneath them, because it's the highest-leverage work we have in oncology right now.

You should be comfortable operating without a playbook, because in oncology we're still writing it. Above all, you should be motivated by our mission to increase access to lifesaving treatments and to make sure patients with cancer get the right care at the right time.

Ensure timely escalation and communication of development risks, entitlement challenges, scope changes, schedule delays, and budget impacts.
Prepare executive-level reporting materials and provide concise project updates to senior leadership.
Engage with trade partners to monitor and report on local market conditions, including construction pricing, labor availability, utility constraints, and development trends affecting project execution.

+5 years of experience in Site Civil Engineering/Development/Construction with a focus on due diligence, site design/construction, and entitlements
Strong technical understanding of industrial site development, land use planning, zoning, permitting, and/or entitlement processes.
Proficiency in reading site plans, engineering drawings, entitlement documents, and construction plans.

Computer proficiency: MS Project or Smartsheet, Google Earth, Bluebeam Revu.

Strong financial acumen with experience in development budgeting, forecasting, and cost management.
Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
Must have excellent written and oral communication skills
Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager – Software Implementation (Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution & Benefits)
new_jobs.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together

At TELUS Health, we're transforming how organizations manage retirement and benefits for their employees. Our Retirement & Benefit Solutions team partners with leading Canadian and US companies to implement and modernize Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, and Health & Welfare benefits administration platforms.

As a Project Manager, you'll be the connective tissue that keeps our implementation projects on track. You'll work directly with a senior project lead to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery initiatives—helping ensure that our clients successfully transition to modern benefits platforms while our internal teams stay aligned, informed, and empowered to do their best work.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, operations, and client success. You'll see your impact immediately—from the moment you help organize a kickoff meeting to the day a client goes live on their new platform. You'll also have the opportunity to modernize how we work by exploring Agile and DevOps practices, and by leveraging AI tools to streamline reporting and documentation.

If you're organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping teams moving forward together, this could be the right fit.

What you'll do

Day-to-day, you'll:

Coordinate implementation delivery across cross-functional teams (Configuration, Data, QA, Product, Development, Integration, Operations, and client stakeholders), keeping everyone aligned on scope, schedule, and milestones
Own project tracking and reporting—creating and maintaining detailed plans, action logs, risk/issue/dependency (RAID) logs, milestone trackers, and status materials that inform leadership and clients
Facilitate working sessions and team meetings, document decisions and action items, and follow up to ensure accountability
Spot risks and dependencies early and partner with senior leaders on mitigation strategies
Prepare client-facing status updates, deliverable tracklists, meeting materials, and follow-up communications—helping maintain strong client relationships and confidence
Support hands-on delivery activities: plan configuration, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, contributions, data migration, systems testing, interfaces, and operational readiness
Uphold PMO governance by applying templates and standards consistently across all projects
Experiment with modern delivery practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) to improve how our teams plan and execute
Use AI tools and copilots to boost your own productivity—drafting meeting notes, summarizing actions, writing status reports, and handling routine communications more efficiently
Contribute ideas to improve how we deliver, report on progress, and work as a team

This role is about solving puzzles. You'll manage multiple dependencies across teams, navigate complexity, and create clarity in situations where there are lots of moving pieces. You'll also be a trusted point of contact for both internal teams and clients who need someone they can rely on.

What you bring

To succeed, you'll have:

2–3 years of project management experience, ideally supporting:
Defined Benefit pension, Defined Contribution pension, or benefits administration implementations
Benefits technology or software implementations
Client-facing implementation projects

Foundational knowledge of project delivery methodologies—Waterfall, Agile, hybrid, or a mix of approaches
Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Hands-on experience with project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
Practical awareness of pension and benefits concepts like plan rules, eligibility, enrollment, contributions, data exchange, interfaces, testing, and go-live readiness
Comfort using generative AI and automation tools to improve your own productivity, documentation, project tracking, and reporting

It's a bonus if you have:

Experience supporting Defined Benefit, Defined Contribution, or Health & Welfare benefits implementation projects
French language skills or experience supporting French-speaking clients and teams
Hands-on involvement in platform implementations, client onboarding, annual/open enrollment cycles, data migration, or testing activities
PMP certification (or you're working toward it)

Above all: You're organized, proactive, detail-minded, and energized by keeping teams aligned and moving forward. You communicate clearly, take initiative to solve problems, and genuinely enjoy coordinating complex work across multiple groups.

Salary Range:
$70,000 - $90,000

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.

TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:

Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
Generous company matched pension
Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills

Why TELUS Health

You'll be part of a team modernizing benefits administration for thousands of organizations across North America. Your work helps employees access the retirement and health benefits they've earned—so you're contributing to something meaningful. Plus, you'll have opportunities to grow your project management skills, explore new delivery approaches, and leverage emerging technologies like AI to work smarter every day.

A Bit About Us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

Experience with large industrial, aerospace, manufacturing, military, and brownfield remediation programs is highly desirable.

Project and Program Management

Manage large-scale environmental remediation projects from proposal through closure.
Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and health and safety plans.
Lead multidisciplinary teams of geologists, engineers, hydrogeologists, risk assessors, and environmental scientists.
Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, profitability, utilization, and forecasting.
Coordinate subcontractors, laboratories, drilling contractors, and remediation vendors.
Maintain quality assurance and quality control standards.

Technical Leadership

PCE (Tetrachloroethylene)
TCE (Trichloroethylene)
cis-1,2-DCE
Vinyl Chloride
Other chlorinated VOCs

Design and oversee:
Site investigations
Groundwater characterization
Soil vapor intrusion assessments
Human health and ecological risk assessments
Remedial investigations/feasibility studies (RI/FS)
Corrective action programs

Evaluate and implement remediation technologies such as:
In situ chemical reduction (ISCR)
In situ chemical oxidation (ISCO)
Enhanced reductive dechlorination (ERD)
Thermal remediation
Soil vapor extraction (SVE)
Dual-phase extraction (DPE)
Air sparging
Monitored natural attenuation (MNA)

Client Relationship Management

Act as primary client contact for key accounts.
Support strategic planning with industrial, aerospace, petroleum, manufacturing, and government clients.
Prepare and present technical findings to clients, regulators, and stakeholders.
Maintain long-term client relationships while identifying opportunities for additional services.

Business Development

Lead proposal preparation and pricing.
Support capture planning and opportunity pursuit.
Identify new clients and expand existing accounts.
Participate in industry organizations and conferences.

Regulatory Expertise

Demonstrated Experience Working With

EPA CERCLA/Superfund programs
RCRA Corrective Action
State cleanup programs
Vapor intrusion guidance
UST and industrial facility closure programs
California DTSC and Regional Water Board programs

Qualifications

BS in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Hydrogeology, Geology, or related field.
12+ years of environmental consulting experience.
7+ years managing complex remediation projects.
Demonstrated success managing projects exceeding $500K to $5M+ annually.
Significant chlorinated solvent investigation and remediation experience.
California PE, PG, CHG, PMP, REM, CHMM (preferred)

Company-paid life, short, and long-term disability.

Cross-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.
Performance-based bonuses or other incentives.

About Skylight
Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.
We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.
If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.
The work we do matters.

About the job
At Skylight, engagement managers are responsible for driving the overall success of our client work. They draw on their expertise in areas such as agile project management practices, agile coaching at the organizational and team levels, project status and progress reporting, risk/issue management, stakeholder management, continual improvement, and contract administration in order to deliver the highest levels of client service and work.
Skylight has partnered with the U.S. Air Force across multiple legacy modernization efforts. The work spans modernization of legacy systems, new capability development in multi-vendor environments, iteration on established platforms, all inside an agile transformation and broader organizational change.

You’ll lead this engagement end to end: owning the client relationship, keeping delivery on track across several teams and vendors, and shaping how Skylight grows the account. It’s a highly complex and consultative environment, so you’ll spend as much time aligning stakeholders and enabling your government partners as you do managing the work.

Your first 30 days are about working with the Skylight team and government personnel, learning the client’s domain and organization, and enabling your government partners. Access to users varies from team to team, so you’ll need to get creative about how you reach them. The client is early- to mid-transformation, so expect organizational and operational change along the way.
This role is contingent on Skylight being awarded the underlying contract. If we’re not awarded the contract, we’ll let you know promptly and discuss whether there are other opportunities that fit.

What you’ll do
Translate the client’s objectives and constraints into an engagement approach that’ll deliver a unique experience and impactful results in the shortest amount of time possible
Build trust with a wide range of stakeholders across the client organization, partner vendors, and Skylight, and keep them aligned on priorities and progress
Manage multiple projects aimed at delivering transformation or a specific product using the appropriate methodologies (e.g., Scrum or kanban)
Set up the team for successful delivery by removing obstacles, coaching them on how to become more collaborative and self-organizing, and enabling the work they do rather than impose how it’s done
Identify opportunities to expand Skylight’s work with the client, and help shape proposals, renewals, and account strategy
Provide management- and team-level visibility into the status and health of the engagement

Basic qualifications
Understand how to apply agile principles to project and program management
Ability to understand client needs and build long-lasting, meaningful relationships with them
Ability to grow Skylight’s business through business development activities
Can cultivate team health, including establishing psychologically safe environments
Can ensure that each project is staffed with the appropriate level and types of personnel
Can ensure that teams are compliant with their contract’s terms and conditions
Strong stakeholder management skills in complex, multi-vendor environments
Interest in mentoring, coaching, and pairing with government partners so they can carry the work forward
Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery
A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves
Military or government experience
Experience leading legacy modernization or agile transformation efforts
Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings
A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Other requirements
Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.
All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.
This contract requires U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment.
You must be able to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC), which requires a favorable background check.
You must complete a company background check successfully.

Position type
This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location
This is a fully remote position.

Travel
Expect occasional travel to Air Force bases across the U.S., quarterly at most.

Expected start date
November 2026

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! Senior Engagement Manager: $150,000–$185,000

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. Axe Compute is seeking a Deployment Program Manager who can track multiple simultaneous GPU cluster deployments end to end, report progress to clients and internal stakeholders up to the executive team and Board, and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies across every workstream that has to come together to bring a cluster live. This role requires genuine fluency in the GPU cluster deployment lifecycle, not just generic project management.

ROLE AT A GLANCE

Mandate: Own program management for multiple concurrent GPU cluster deployments, from contract signature through customer go-live.
Scope: Multi-workstream project planning, cross-vendor coordination (OEMs, data center operators, network service providers), client and executive/Board reporting, risk and dependency management.
Key Outcomes: Predictable contract-to-go-live timelines across concurrent deployments, accurate and proactive risk identification, reporting that satisfies both client stakeholders and executive/Board audiences.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Multi-Cluster Program Tracking

Build and maintain sophisticated, dependency-aware project plans covering every workstream in a deployment: OEM hardware manufacturing and shipment, data center build-out, cluster build-out and provisioning, and network service provider dependencies.
Track multiple concurrent deployments simultaneously, on a global scale, maintaining a clear view of status, risk, and critical path across all of them.

Client & Executive Reporting

Produce and deliver progress reporting to client stakeholders, translating technical status into terms relevant to their go-live planning.
Produce and deliver internal reporting to executive leadership and the Board, summarizing status, risk, and financial impact of deployment execution across the portfolio.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Proactively identify risks, issues, bottlenecks, and cross-workstream dependencies before they affect schedule or budget.
Own risk mitigation planning and escalation, coordinating the right stakeholders to resolve issues quickly.

Cross-Vendor & Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate directly with OEM manufacturers on hardware orders and shipment timing, data center operators on build-out schedules, and network service providers on connectivity dependencies.
Work with the Lead GPU Cluster Solution Architect, Data Center Procurement and Operations Director, and Supply Chain to ensure every workstream is reflected accurately in the project plan.

Technical Fluency Across the Deployment Lifecycle

Maintain working knowledge of GPU architecture and the full set of components and phases that go into building a cluster from scratch: data center readiness, equipment delivery and installation, vendor coordination (MSPs, data center operators, OEMs), and acceptance testing cycles.
Use this fluency to ask the right questions, spot schedule risk early, and communicate credibly with technical stakeholders on all sides.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years in program or project management for infrastructure, data center, telecom, or large-scale technology deployments, with direct experience managing multiple concurrent, complex projects.
Demonstrated understanding of GPU cluster architecture and the end-to-end deployment lifecycle (data center readiness, hardware delivery/installation, network turn-up, acceptance testing).
Experience coordinating directly with OEM manufacturers, data center operators, and network/connectivity vendors.
Experience producing reporting for both client-facing and executive/Board-facing audiences.
Strong tools proficiency (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar) for complex, multi-workstream project tracking.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

PMP certification or equivalent.
Prior experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler, or GPU infrastructure provider.
Familiarity with NVIDIA Reference Architecture and cluster acceptance testing standards.

You'll be part of a team of three TPMs collectively responsible for launching 36 SoRs and branches in 2026, with each TPM owning a portfolio of launches that will unlock incremental revenue while addressing critical tax exposure and regulatory requirements.

Key job responsibilities

As a TPM III for SoR Launch Acceleration, you will own the end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of SoR launches within the broader 2026 program. Working independently with limited guidance, you'll coordinate across multiple teams in the AWS Billing organization and partner with regional compliance, legal, tax, and business development teams to ensure successful launches.

Program Ownership & Execution

Own a portfolio of SoR launches spanning multiple countries and business lines, managing the complete lifecycle from requirements gathering through production launch
Drive delivery across multiple engineering teams including SoR development, billing systems, tax engines, payment processing, and regional infrastructure teams
Coordinate complex dependencies between SoR configuration, billing system integration, tax compliance requirements, payment provider onboarding, and regulatory approvals
Manage launch timelines balancing business urgency (compliance deadlines, revenue opportunities) with technical readiness and quality standards
Accelerate delivery velocity by leveraging AI-native development approaches, identifying opportunities to use configs over custom code, and streamlining testing processes

Cross-Functional Coordination

Partner with regional teams to gather requirements for country-specific tax rules, regulatory compliance, payment methods, and business entity structures
Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure SoR structures meet regulatory requirements (e.g., EECC for Telco, PCI for SAS, local tax laws)
Coordinate with business development to understand revenue models, pricing structures, and go-to-market timing for each SoR
Align with tax teams on PST (Provincial Sales Tax), VAT, GST, and other jurisdiction-specific tax requirements
Engage payment providers for local payment method integration and compliance with regional payment regulations

Technical Program Management

Define clear requirements for each SoR launch, working backwards from customer and regulatory needs to technical specifications
Drive architectural decisions on when to use configuration vs. custom code, ensuring solutions are maintainable and scalable
Manage the AI-native development approach by coordinating with teams using the SoR coding agent, validating generated configs, and ensuring expert review loops are effective
Establish testing strategies that enable 3-week UAT/PVT cycles through spec-driven testing and automation
Identify and mitigate risks including regulatory approval delays, payment provider integration issues, tax engine configuration complexity, and cross-team dependencies

Process Innovation & Efficiency

Streamline launch processes by creating predictable paths for SoR development, testing, and deployment
Identify bottlenecks in the current launch approach and work with teams to eliminate unnecessary steps or manual handoffs
Drive adoption of AI-native methods by demonstrating value, addressing team concerns, and refining the approach based on learnings
Create reusable patterns for common SoR configurations, testing scenarios, and launch checklists that accelerate future launches
Establish metrics and visibility to track progress, identify issues early, and communicate status to stakeholders

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Communicate program status clearly and concisely to Senior Managers and Directors, highlighting progress, risks, and decisions needed
Build consensus across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities—engineering teams focused on technical quality, business teams focused on launch dates, compliance teams focused on regulatory requirements
Manage escalations effectively when blockers arise, knowing when to resolve issues directly vs. when to escalate to leadership
Drive crisp decisions on scope, timeline, and resource trade-offs to keep launches on track

A day in the life

Complex Cross-Functional Coordination

Multi-team dependencies: Coordinate delivery across SoR development, billing systems, tax engines, payment processing, regional infrastructure, and compliance teams
Regional variations: Navigate country-specific requirements for tax rules, payment methods, regulatory compliance, and business entity structures
Stakeholder alignment: Build consensus among engineering teams, business stakeholders, legal/compliance teams, and regional partners with different priorities and constraints

Technical Complexity

SoR configuration: Define and validate complex configurations for tax rules, payment flows, invoice formats, and regulatory reporting
System integration: Ensure SoRs integrate correctly with existing billing systems, tax engines, payment providers, and financial reporting systems
AI-native development: Manage the transition to config-driven development using SoR coding agents while maintaining quality and compliance standards
Testing at scale: Design testing strategies that validate SoR functionality across multiple scenarios within compressed 3-week cycles

Ambiguity & Risk Management

Undefined requirements: Work with regional teams to clarify vague or incomplete requirements for tax rules, compliance needs, and business processes
Regulatory uncertainty: Navigate evolving regulatory landscapes where requirements may change during development
Dependency risks: Proactively identify and mitigate risks from external dependencies (payment providers, regulatory approvals, legal entity formation)
Timeline pressure: Balance business urgency for launches with technical readiness and quality standards

Process Transformation

Change management: Drive adoption of AI-native development approaches among teams accustomed to traditional coding methods
Efficiency improvement: Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the launch process without compromising quality or compliance
Scalability: Establish processes that enable sustainable SoR launches beyond the 2026 program

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

new_jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least October 7, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Addison, TX, USA; Thornton, CO, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in technical program management.
Experience in network reliability or network health management for hyperscale optical networks (e.g., long-haul terrestrial dark fiber, metro networks, or carrier hotels).
Experience planning and executing network migrations or infrastructure expansions (e.g., capacity planning, asset transitions, or fiber route upgrades).

Preferred qualifications:

5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Knowledge of regional network providers and fiber networks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a data-driven problem-solving approach to solve issues.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of this team, you will plan, design, and acquire the scalable network infrastructure to deliver the fastest, most reliable experience to users across the region and around the globe. You will connect Google's fleet of data centers, Cloud customers, and users by planning and acquiring long-haul and metro terrestrial dark fiber networks, colocation space and power, and other critical assets.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Collaborate with internal business and cross-functional networking technical teams to identify and define tactical initiatives necessary to meet Google's network infrastructure needs for both expansion and cost optimization.
Translate demand forecasts into regional capacity plans over time, taking into account market trends and technology changes to ensure the most optimized and cost effective network solution, translating this to asset/infrastructure requirements.
Present network plans and roadmaps for approval by all internal stakeholders that range from short-term augments to long-term region-wide strategies for Google network.
Manage the execution of approved network plans by co-ordinating with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on-time and within allocated budget.
